research.scope: Public guidance about symptoms, daily functioning and seeking help; no diagnosis or claim that questioning causes illness.

limitations: No empirical claim that all people possess a coherent worldview.
No clinical assessment; signs of distress do not decide philosophical truth.
Original benefits/risks are possibilities, not outcome guarantees.
